bound_by: paper evaluator, at ontology acceptance and before phase two, from the accepted population surface only. The evaluator's one judgement is each question's type set; this script expands it into every ordered pair of those types under every relation type on the surface, projecting each type's non-housekeeping slots. No population, admission, replay, row or row count existed when the type sets were written, so no binding here was selected against a result. Run-04's binding was revised twice after its rows were seen (deep sweep D-01); this is the change that closes it.

expansion.rule: every ordered pair of a question's types under every relation type on the surface, each type projecting its non-housekeeping slots
